_comment: Solitaire (Klondike) screenshot capture. 500-deal CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-499, display deal = idx+1). Every slot is a gameplay table at a distinct deal (one slot is a seeded draw-3 Random deal) and a distinct table theme: window._ksShot(idx,theme,moves,{hint,c4,rand}) applies Solitaire's real theme palette (window._KS_THEMES: felt/felt2/back/back2/trim/slot) + midnight chrome, deals the board and plays the first N moves of its stored winning line (stops before every card is face-up so auto-finish never runs), optionally lights a Hint or four-colour suits. Phone ships 7, tablets 2 each.
